The '''''Ilthmar's Fist''''' was a [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A part of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], it participated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Following the battle, a council of war occurred in order to establish the proper course of action for Death Squadron, which was in disarray following its heavy losses at the battle. As the [[Military rank/Legends|ranking]] Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]], [[Adye Prittick]], was indecisive, Admiral [[Blitzer Harrsk]] acrimoniously broke up the council of war by announcing he was bringing the ''Ilthmar's Fist'', as well as a substantial portion of Death Squadron, to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] until an unambiguous line of command could be established.<ref name="EGW" /> Harrsk's Deep Core forces eventually became a splinter faction known as [[Zero Command]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Ilthmar's Fist'' was mentioned in [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]'s [[2012]] reference book, ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.<ref name="EGW" />
